name: Lisa
title: Witch of Purple Rose
description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

skills.name: Lightning Touch
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 lightning attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Electro, Lisa plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Violet Arc
skills.description:
Channels the power of lightning to sweep bothersome matters away.

Press
Releases a homing Lightning Orb.
On hit, it deals Electro DMG and applies a stack of the Conductive status (max 3 stacks) to opponents in a small AoE.

Hold
After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby opponents.
Deals great amounts of extra damage to opponents based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.
skills.info: Electro Purple is the raiment of the Witch of Purple Rose.

skills.name: Lightning Rose
skills.description:
Summons a Lightning Rose that unleashes powerful lightning bolts, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Electro DMG.
The Lightning Rose will continuously emit lightning to knock back opponents and deal Electro DMG throughout the ability's duration.
skills.info: This rose is beautiful, but beware its mortal thorns.

passives.name: Induced Aftershock
passives.description: Hits by Charged Attacks apply Violet Arc's Conductive status to opponents.

passives.name: Static Electricity Field
passives.description: Opponents hit by Lightning Rose have their DEF decreased by 15% for 10s.

passives.name: General Pharmaceutics
passives.description: When Lisa crafts a potion, she has a 20% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

constellations.name: Infinite Circuit
constellations.description:
Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc.
A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

constellations.name: Electromagnetic Field
constellations.description:
Holding Violet Arc has the following effects:
·Increases DEF by 25%.
·Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.

constellations.name: Resonant Thunder
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Plasma Eruption
constellations.description: Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.

constellations.name: Electrocute
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Violet Arc by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pulsating Witch
constellations.description:
When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc's Conductive status onto nearby opponents.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

outfits.name: A Sobriquet Under Shade
outfits.description: An outfit Lisa had someone commission for her when she revisited Sumeru. A perfect blend of practicality and elegance, the dress bears a resemblance to Lisa's old uniform from her Akademiya days.

outfits.name: Purple Rose
outfits.description: Lisa's outfit. A slim-fit dress adorned with roses that displays a young lady's elegance.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Hi darling, are you going to be Lisa's little helper? What? Me, a grand mage? That was a long time ago, I'm just a humble librarian now. *chuckles* Don't worry darling, I'll take very good care of you. So...

voices.title: Chat: Afternoon Tea
voices.text: It's nearly time for afternoon tea.

voices.title: Chat: Quest
voices.text: Why not keep me company for a while... There'll be plenty of time for work later.

voices.title: Chat: Better to Stay In
voices.text: Today's no good for going out... Hmm... Did I say that yesterday as well?

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: *sigh* Perfect weather for sipping a cup of tea while gazing out the window.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: When I practice my spells in weather like this, I can do half the work for double the impact. Haha, I'm just teasing.

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: Such a calming breeze... Perfect for taking a nap, don't you think?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: *yawn* Good morning, Jean... Oh, it's you! Sorry, dear.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It must almost be time for a nap...

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: You're still up? I'm getting sleepy...

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: I can see how hard you've been working today. Let me think of a way to reward you...

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: I'm not lazy, I just know to save my energy for when I need it most.

voices.title: About Us: Relationships
voices.text: I can be your teacher, your master, or your friend... or all three if you want...

voices.title: About Us: Capabilities
voices.text: Let me show you a thing or two, lest we let your efforts go to waste. *chuckles*

voices.title: About Us: Ceremony
voices.text: Wait, one last thing... A kiss on the forehead from master to follower. Now you're my star pupil.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Visions? Ah, they're a necessary device in controlling the elements — with you being the sole exception, of course. Hmm... As for why that is, perhaps... we can find the time to experiment a little?

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Feel free to use the alchemist's upstairs from the library whenever you want. But make sure you knock first... we wouldn't want you seeing anything you're not supposed to, now would we?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Calla Lilies are a medicinal flower with antidotal properties. With them in hand, there's no need to worry about the side effects of any potions... Hehe.

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Jean is a gifted and dedicated leader. Seeing how hard she works makes even me want to help her out.

voices.title: About Amber
voices.text: Amber was just a young girl when she joined the knights, and in the blink of an eye, she's turned into such a strong young lady. I'm curious to see what she'll be like a few years from now.

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: Have you heard Barbara sing before? Her angelic voice contains a magical healing energy. A different kind of magical energy from the one in my potions, of course. I wonder which one you prefer?

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: You want to know about Diluc? Haha, in that case, I know someone else you should talk to.

voices.title: About Razor
voices.text: Come on Razor, that's it, good boy! Let's do some combat practice — I've found you the perfect partner. Hey! Come back!

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Last time little Klee wanted to use my workshop for her experiments, I had to say no, and she was angry at me for the rest of the day. *sigh* What happened the next day, you ask? She went off happily to play outside of course.

voices.title: About Mona
voices.text: As for Mona? She seems to be an excellent mage, but I'm not a part of their Hexenzirkel. The idea of Irminsul exploration and formal tea parties just leaves me cold.

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: Albedo is quite the alchemist. Just say the word and he'll come up with a good solution. He's easy on the eyes too, just like you.

voices.title: About Fischl
voices.text: Fischl, yes, she's always in the library looking to borrow fantasy novels. She always returns her books three days early and looks after them very well. She's a good kid.

voices.title: About Noelle
voices.text: Every time I ask Noelle to dust off the bookshelves, I'm always left with the sense that the more exhausted I make her, the happier she becomes. Yes, who knows what's going on with her... *chuckles*

voices.title: About Sucrose
voices.text: Try not to bother Sucrose if you're at a loose end, you'll only startle the poor girl. She's gifted at interacting with all sorts of exotic creatures — just hopeless when it comes to humans.

voices.title: About Cyno
voices.text: I've barely kept in touch with anyone from the Akademiya since leaving Sumeru, except for the occasional letters to my teachers out of basic courtesy. Fortunately, not every promising student turned out as lazy as I am... I heard that one of my juniors, Cyno, now leads quite the action-packed life.

voices.title: About Collei
voices.text: Ah, dear little Collei. Every time she writes to me, she tries out new words and expressions she's learned recently... Hehe, no wonder she's improving so quickly. That wonderful and warmhearted master of hers must have helped a lot too.

voices.title: About Mika
voices.text: I do rather envy Huffman for having such a caring little brother. Mika takes care of everything around the house and even looks after him when he's drunk... Ah, how nice it must be to lounge around all day without a care in the world... Hmm? What do you mean, I already do that? You're getting quite bold these days, aren't you, cutie?

voices.title: About Prune
voices.text: Little cutey Prune... Did you know she likes obscure, arcane books? Whenever I get close or give her a smile, she starts squirming like a Glaze Medaka. Hehe, it's so utterly adorable! I'm glad I'm not the "witch" she's hunting — I don't know what I'd do with such a serious little slip on my case.

voices.title: More About Lisa: I
voices.text: So, which element would you like to learn about today?

voices.title: More About Lisa: II
voices.text: My past? So, you want to get to know me a little better, huh? *chuckles* That's a story for another day. But I'm touched that you asked.

voices.title: More About Lisa: III
voices.text: When I taught Razor how to utilize Elemental Energy, I never expected him to master the technique so quickly. Come to think of it, you're talented too. Maybe I could teach you a few tricks...

voices.title: More About Lisa: IV
voices.text: What's that? You want to learn some Sumeru Akademiya magic? I'm afraid it might be a bit too much for you to handle right now... Hmm, though I suppose it can't hurt to teach you some of the basics. Here, start by reading the beginner's guide, it's only 800 pages or so.

voices.title: More About Lisa: V
voices.text: A Vision may seem like a great tool, but one day, the power one accumulates always finds a way to turn back on you. Should such a day come for me, so long as you're around... Ah, never mind.

voices.title: Lisa's Hobbies
voices.text: Hey darling, would you like to try one of my magic potions? There's no knowing what it will do to you until you try it, though... Don't say I didn't warn you!

voices.title: Lisa's Troubles
voices.text: The interrogation room upstairs has sat there unused for two years now... It would be a much more lively place if Hertha would agree to let me use it as my private workshop... *sigh* She's such a spoilsport.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I like making my own vegetable soup. I put a big bunch of vegetables into a cauldron and stir it with a long spoon. What does it taste like? Here, why don't you try it for yourself. Open wide!

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I suffer from extreme pumpkinphobia. The fall harvest is a difficult time of year for me, as you can imagine. I wonder if it would be worth the trouble to make all the pumpkins in the world disappear...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Oh aren't you just the sweetest? Thanks, cutie, you just made my day.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Hehe, you've really got a knack for this, haven't you?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Eugh... Oh my... This is really... hmm...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here, take this amulet, it will bring you good luck. It's my birthday gift to you. I spent a long time making it, so don't lose it now!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Surely you don't want me working overtime... That would be no good.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Chances to practice should be left to you newcomers, no?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: *chuckles* If I were to recover my full power, who knows what kind of things might happen?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I've already tried to persuade you every way possible... *sigh* Have it your way, cutie. I can no longer go on pretending at this point — even a Hilichurl would see through the act. So be it, let me introduce you to the true Witch of Purple Rose.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: *giggles*

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: You're in for a little shock.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Come a little closer.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: ...Blitz!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: You've been a naughty boy!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI
voices.text: Hehe~

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Let's spark things up a little.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Surrender and I'll be gentle.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Try not to enjoy this too much.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: No pain no gain, haha...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Oh my...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: What do you think, cutie?

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: I have some for you too.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: I'm a bit rusty...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Oh no, I'm gonna ruin my gloves.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Don't force it, darling.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Do you need me to lend a hand?

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Going out is tiring...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Looks like I got carried away...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: I knew I should have stayed home...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ugh...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Don't be such a brute.

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Here, let me help you.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: I'll keep an eye on you.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Ooh, you're taking me out?
